types.name: strategies.v1.DeployStatus.State
types.doc: State is a deploy proposal's step.

values.name: PROPOSED
values.doc: Recorded; waiting for the user to deploy it.

values.name: VALIDATING
values.doc: Checking the version, its behaviour examples and limits again.

values.name: SETTING_ACCESS
values.doc:
Setting the bot's limits and its trading key, until the exchange
 applies them. Comes after CREATING_SUBACCOUNT and before FUNDING.

values.name: FUNDING
values.doc: Moving the funding into the bot's subaccount.

values.name: LIVE
values.doc: The bot runs: bot_id is set.

values.name: FAILED
values.doc: The deploy stopped: failure says why.

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc: The user did not deploy the proposal in time.
